title: The Star Garden
subtitle: A Questlight adventure with Lumo · ~6 min
synopsis: A tiny star fell into the Nest garden. Lumo’s Questlight helps you choose a safe first step. Heartlights are essence — never separate creatures.

nodes.title: Fallen spark
nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.body:
The Star Garden glows. A tiny star rests between soft moss and Sprout’s leaf markers.

Lumo’s Questlight pulse-beats like a friendly game save point.

choices.label: Look carefully before touching
choices.memory: We looked carefully at the fallen star.
choices.line: Pause. Check the path. Choose our next move together.

choices.label: Ask the star if it wants help (kind)
choices.memory: We asked the tiny star a kind question.

nodes.title: Trail Scout check
nodes.speaker: sprout
nodes.body:
Traillight says: small steps. The star is warm, not hot. No deep holes. Safe edge first.

Let’s I-lumming-Nate the way.

choices.label: Follow Sprout’s leafy steps
choices.memory: Sprout marked safe leafy steps to the star.

choices.label: Safety First: call a grown-up if needed
choices.memory: We chose Safety First before helping the star.

nodes.title: A tiny wish
nodes.speaker: lumo
nodes.body:
The star whispers: “I got lost on a big map.”

Big maps need small co-op quests. Let’s pick one safe move.

choices.label: Turn it into a tiny co-op quest
choices.memory: We turned a big lost-star problem into a small quest.

choices.label: Invite Luna to name the feeling
choices.memory: Luna helped name the star’s lost feeling.

nodes.title: Safe co-op
nodes.speaker: lumo
nodes.body:
Questlight says: when something feels bigger than us, we check with a grown-up first.

That is not quitting — that is teamwork.

choices.label: Teamwork accepted — continue gently
choices.memory: We treated Safety First as teamwork, not a stop.

nodes.title: Words of light
nodes.speaker: luna
nodes.body:
Dreamlight sketches a path of stars home.

Feeling lost can become a picture — then a plan.

choices.label: Carry the picture back to Lumo
choices.memory: A Dreamlight picture became our next plan.

nodes.title: Gentle lift
nodes.speaker: lumo
nodes.body:
Together we cup the star. It giggles light.

Moki pops in with a kind joke: “Plot twist — friendship is the map!”

choices.label: Laugh kindly and place the star high
choices.memory: Moki’s kind joke made the star garden braver.

choices.label: Offer the Nest as a soft rest stop
choices.memory: We offered the Nest as a rest stop for a tired star.

nodes.title: Home constellation
nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.body:
The star finds its place above the garden. Questlight, Traillight, Dreamlight, and Sparklight shimmer as essence — not separate creatures.

You chose a safe first step. That is how big maps get small.

nodes.title: Nest rest
nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.body:
The star naps in a moss bowl. Tomorrow it can try again.

Heartlights glow quiet and proud. Rest is part of every good quest.
